profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website text describes an investment focus on companies positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence, and it references a finance workflow platform that would use proprietary data and world-class AI talent.

The website text also includes commentary on AI's economic effects. It states that AI will make expertise near free and asks who will build the first billion-dollar revenue company with fewer than 100 employees. It suggests the business model of elite universities may collapse when the ROI of a $300,000 law or medical degree evaporates. It also raises a question about whether capital gains tax preferences should be eliminated, and includes a claim that AI pseudo protectors will harm the bottom 3b people on the planet.

No products or MCP servers are listed for Khosla Ventures, and no cases are recorded. The company has 281 California law exposure entries.
